title: Move the Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs
summary: Retry of structure-pass job G2: move the Transport items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog; about 340 lines) verbatim into gh/transport.rs. Re-export them from gh/mod.rs so public paths stay unchanged, and add a CHANGELOG entry. The audience is the verifier applying section 5 of structure-pass.md.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test, clippy and fmt checks are listed as criteria.
The test list is compared before and after, and the full suite is run.
Only the three named files change.
Criteria use commands the verifier can run.
The CHANGELOG entry is written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The earlier rejection recorded no findings, so the same reading is reused with extra care on the section 5 proof (moved text identical, only import lines edited in tests).
The G1 dependency has landed or is independent of these lines; Transport is a leaf.
Line ranges in structure-pass.md (36-374) may have shifted; the producer locates items by name.
Visibility is preserved; re-exports keep sibling code compiling without changing item text.

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/transport.rs holds the Transport row items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog) with the same text as before; git diff -M --color-moved shows only moved lines.
gh/mod.rs declares `mod transport;` and re-exports each moved item, so no file outside gh/ changes its import path. Test modules have only import lines edited and the test list is unchanged.
The report lists the caller-check Grep for each moved name's old path, as section 5 requires.
Only gh/mod.rs, gh/transport.rs and CHANGELOG.md change, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the move. No config, workflow or other docs file changes.

Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` and check that the test names match the list before the move. Run `cargo test --locked` and check that it passes, including the retry tests that use the moved code.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. Both must be clean.

out_of_scope: Moving any other row of structure-pass.md section 2.1 (other G jobs)
Any behavior change, renaming or refactor of the moved code
Edits to docs/design/structure-pass.md or any config or workflow file
